# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment facts generated for the PhotoAlbum application. Use these documents alongside the main assessment report for modernization planning.

## Supplementary Documents

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) - Application architecture layers and component relationships with Mermaid diagrams.
- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) - External dependency categories, compatibility risks, and test dependency inventory.
- [Api Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) - HTTP/page handler surface, service contracts, communication patterns, and request sequence.
- [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, EF Core entity model, repository access patterns, caching, and data sensitivity.
- [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration files, profiles, runtime settings, secrets workflow, feature flags, and framework versions.
- [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) - Core gallery workflows, business rules, domain mapping, and upload workflow sequence.
